claim_legs.durability: Exact main and preflight copies, first prospective source pins, native witnesses, original digests, complete TAP, admission roots and saved-only audit/recovery are tracked. The Knowledge Map routes to saved verification without any fixture replay.
claim_legs.falsify: Every actual omission is rejected by the unchanged original closure oracle. Native alias substitution, absent witnesses and failed/duplicate/wrong-object recovery reject; rewritten closure flags reject even after rebuilding coherent snapshot digests. Healthy and all unselected handles close normally.
claim_legs.rederive: Current Perl bindings agree with independent source ownership and healthy close order. Native admission/source/lock checks preserve all original assertions outside the declared omission predicates. Original receipt/effect and original closure oracles run unchanged on each untouched snapshot.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before this slice is committed.
limits: Only the ordinary selected representative omissions execute. Other profiles, the complete omission join, final release and native/startup/parent/full CI/push remain open.
scope: Ordinary healthy control and selected representative source, directory and lock omissions. Cross-profile order variations qualify only the pure resolver. Original verdict, native open alias and later recovery remain distinct. No other-profile fixture, original producer/main, compiler, native fixture process or collector; final release and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain gated.
